most_useful_features.description: Cosine-similarity weighted average of training deltas for gene g, where weights are cosine similarities between the target gene of p and the target genes of training perturbations in gene-set space.
Product of an indicator that the target of perturbation p is a neighbor of GATA1 or NFE2 in prior_network and the gene's correlation with globin genes.
Indicator that gene g's protein has a signal peptide (protein_annotation).
Cosine-similarity weighted average of training deltas, scaled by the target protein's length from protein_annotation.
Interaction between gene g's LoF constraint (pLI) and the target gene t's pLI: product of the two, with median imputation of missing values.
Jaccard similarity between gene set memberships of perturbation target and response gene g.
For each (p,g), if gene g is a globin gene (HBZ, HBG2, HBA1, HBG1), the control-cell correlation between the perturbation target gene and g; else 0.
Fraction of leucine (aa_L) in the protein sequence of gene g.
Binary indicator: 1 if the target of perturbation p and gene g share at least one subcellular localization flag from protein_annotation, else 0.
Jaccard similarity between the target gene's gene-set memberships and the union of globin-gene gene sets, broadcast to all genes.
